method: Actual PNG pixels viewed with view_image; all four new images and all four archived first-delivery images inspected.

observations.tracks: Stone/ground variation visible around unchanged portal and rails. Portal interior remains intentionally dark. Existing terrain/profile faceting remains.
observations.overview: Same site silhouette and composition; fine grass/stone and foliage variation is now visible. Detail remains subtle at overview scale.
observations.platform: Timber grain and fine paving variation visible on posts, walls, planter and platform. Original clock, lettering and glass remain legible and solid.
observations.top_down: Station, curved railway and path layout preserved. Fine texture increases surface variation; no checkerboard or missing-material rendering observed.

limitations: Static images do not measure frame rate, streaming behavior or motion aliasing.
Per-polygon UV orientation creates directional discontinuities at some chart boundaries.
The texture pass retains existing terrain/path intersections and geometry proportions.
